1. Code 16: Defense (Core Focus)
2. Code 10: Transportation (Commercial Maritime & Industrial Base)


Subtopic 1610 (Military Procurement & Weapons Systems): 46 Executive Orders (capturing ship procurement, naval conversion programs, and strategic acquisitions).
Subtopic 1007 (Maritime Transportation): 51 Executive Orders (capturing merchant marine shipping, commercial dockyards, and port logistics).
Subtopic 1604 (Military Readiness & Sealift): 39 Executive Orders (capturing Military Sealift Command, mobilization requirements, and fleet readiness).
Subtopic 1608 (Military Manpower & Personnel): 327 Executive Orders (active personnel strength levels and staffing requirements).


What follows are three visualizations showing...
 
- Figure 1: Trends in Presidential Executive Orders: National Defense (Topic 16) vs. Transportation (Topic 10), 1945–2025

- Figure 2: Executive Priorities in Defense: Military Readiness & Strategic Mobilization (Subtopic 1604) vs. Weapons & Naval Procurement (Subtopic 1610), 1945–2025

- Figure 3: Institutional Division of Labor in Defense Procurement: Presidential Orders vs. Enacted Legislation (Subtopic 1610), 1940s–2020s
